newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks close higher on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks close higher on short-covering.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed higher on Wednesday's new accounts day on covering of short-sell positions by jobbers, dealers said.
Karachi bourse 100-share index closed 5.78 points, or 0.37 percent, higher at 1,568.87 amid 139 losers and 125 gainers in a turnover of 50 million, up from Tuesday's 32 million.
Market sentiment was bullish which was initiated by bears, who were found busy in covering their short-sell positions on the new accounts day, a dealer of Ali Husain Rajabali said.
Almost all active and selected stocks except HUBCO posted fresh gains, the dealer said.
The wide gap between the advancing issues and declining ones had narrowed sharply, one broker said and added: "This indicates the market is gaining strength."
Fauji Fertiliser rose 3.0 to 80, Shell 1.0 to 210, Adamjee Insurance 2.0 to 109, PTCL 0.55 to 29.25, ICI 0.25 to 21.85 and FFC Jordan 0.60 to 18.10. HUBCO fell 0.45 to 37.25.
